name: Community Host
blurb: Run the front desk at Nexus: check in members, set up events, meet everyone.

perk.desc: Free hot-desk access at Nexus Co-work while you work there.

lines: You set up chairs for a pitch night. Two founders argue about pricing the whole time.
A member asks where to find cheap suppliers. You point them to Ken.
Coffee machine, printer, Wi-Fi: you fix all three before lunch.
Priya hands you the event calendar. It's full.
